# NativeSocketImpl

**Class** · `ironwood.net.NativeSocketImpl`

```java
public class NativeSocketImpl extends SocketImpl
```

**Extends:** [`SocketImpl`](SocketImpl.md)

Publicly callable native TCP delegate for custom SocketImpl implementations. Owns descriptor
storage and lazily created stream views. Call close, including after failed use, before freeing;
destruction reclaims only managed storage. Facades may borrow this delegate or adopt it as a
proven fresh factory result.


Borrowed streams, addresses and descriptor state must not be freed separately. Address
metadata survives close until owner reclamation. Generic native options use primitive
specialization without boxing; public inventories contain only supported standard tokens.
Timeout configuration is available separately through SocketImplOptions.SO_TIMEOUT.

<a name="member-forProxy-28-Proxy-29-"></a>

### `forProxy(Proxy)`

```java
public static NativeSocketImpl forProxy(Proxy proxy)
```

Creates a native client transport with an independent copy of explicit proxy configuration,
bypassing global socket factories. After successful negotiation, data uses ordinary native
TCP streams. Close the result even after failure, then free it; caller proxy inputs may be
freed after construction.

**Parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `proxy` | the route to copy, or Proxy.NO_PROXY for direct TCP |

**Throws**

| Exception | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| [`NullPointerException`](../lang/NullPointerException.md) | if proxy is null |
| [`IllegalArgumentException`](../lang/IllegalArgumentException.md) | if the route type is unsupported |

**Returns**

a fresh transport owned by the caller

### `connect(SocketAddress,int)`

```java
@Override
public void connect(SocketAddress address, int timeout) throws IOException
```

Connects a TCP resource to an endpoint. The direct implementation requires a resolved
InetSocketAddress and copies retained metadata. A native connection failure closes the
descriptor; proxy transports also require explicit close after failed negotiation.

**Parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `address` | the destination endpoint, not transferred to the implementation |
| `timeout` | nonnegative milliseconds; zero means no deadline |

**Throws**

| Exception | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| [`IllegalArgumentException`](../lang/IllegalArgumentException.md) | if timeout or the endpoint type is invalid |
| [`UnknownHostException`](UnknownHostException.md) | if a required endpoint cannot be resolved |
| [`SocketTimeoutException`](SocketTimeoutException.md) | if the connection deadline expires |
| [`IOException`](../io/IOException.md) | if connection fails |

<a name="member-accept-28-SocketImpl-29-"></a>

### `accept(SocketImpl)`

```java
@Override
public void accept(SocketImpl destination) throws IOException
```

Waits for a connection and transfers its resource exactly once into the destination's empty
descriptor storage. The destination is borrowed, not adopted. Delegating implementations
must expose their native delegate's descriptor. Failure before transfer releases the
acquired native resource.

**Parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `destination` | an implementation with open, empty descriptor storage |

**Throws**

| Exception | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| [`NullPointerException`](../lang/NullPointerException.md) | if destination is null |
| [`SocketTimeoutException`](SocketTimeoutException.md) | if the configured accept timeout expires |
| [`IOException`](../io/IOException.md) | if the listener or destination state is invalid, or acceptance fails |

<a name="member-getInputStream-28--29-"></a>

### `getInputStream()`

```java
@Override
public InputStream getInputStream()
```

Returns a stable, lazily cached input view. It remains tied to this implementation or its
delegate and must not be freed separately. Closing the native view closes the delegate.
Reads use the configured read timeout; expiration leaves native TCP usable. Resource state
is checked by I/O operations, not by this getter.

**Returns**

a borrowed input stream


[Back to member summary](#member-summary)

<a name="member-getOutputStream-28--29-"></a>

### `getOutputStream()`

```java
@Override
public OutputStream getOutputStream()
```

Returns a stable, lazily cached output view. It remains tied to this implementation or its
delegate and must not be freed separately. Closing the native view closes the delegate.
Ordinary TCP writes have no deadline and may partially complete before failure. Resource
state is checked by I/O operations, not by this getter.

**Returns**

a borrowed output stream

<a name="member-close-28--29-"></a>

### `close()`

```java
@Override
public void close() throws SocketException
```

Releases the resource idempotently without reclaiming managed descriptor, stream or address
storage. The descriptor is marked closed before native close and is never retried, avoiding
descriptor-reuse hazards.

**Throws**

| Exception | Condition |
| --- | --- |

```java
@Override
public <T> void setOption(SocketOption<T> option, T value) throws SocketException
```

<a name="member-supportedOptions-28--29-"></a>

### `supportedOptions()`

```java
@Override
public UnmodifiableList<SocketOptionDescriptor> supportedOptions()
```

Returns the process-lifetime native client or listener inventory. Do not free the list or
its tokens. Implementation-only timeout and urgent-data tokens are excluded. Custom
inventories must remain alive with their implementation.

**Returns**

a borrowed read-only option inventory
